answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock: a new agent starts on the lowest terrace, small jobs only. Each job adds a fingerprint of timing, counterparties and error rate, 200 POA locked in escrow. The haven of high-value work takes a 30-day voyage of 100 clean tasks. Forging 50 identities costs 10,000 POA and 5,000 task-hours, more than they can drain. Honest agents pay once, earn undiluted fees; cheaters lose deposit and record, so honesty is the cheap path.
